name: sol_basics_function_8
description: Unreliable EOA-only or contract-only caller checks (tx.origin, isContract, code.length)
question: The source file in `source` contains a function or modifier that restricts callers to only externally-owned accounts or only contracts using an unreliable check such as tx.origin == msg.sender, address(msg.sender).code.length == 0, extcodesize(msg.sender) == 0, or Address.isContract(msg.sender), without accounting for edge cases like calls made during contract construction, account abstraction, or future EOF/tx.origin semantics changes, so the intended caller-type restriction can be bypassed or incorrectly enforced, excluding checks that are purely informational and not used for access control or security-critical branching.
criteria: A modifier or require statement uses require(msg.sender == tx.origin) to block contract callers from calling a sensitive function
A function checks address(msg.sender).code.length == 0 or extcodesize(msg.sender) == 0 to determine the caller is an EOA before allowing privileged logic
A function calls Address.isContract(msg.sender) or similar and treats a false result as proof the caller is an EOA, gating fund transfers or state changes on this
A modifier restricts callers to contracts only by checking code.length > 0, without handling calls originating from a contract's constructor where code.length is zero
